issues.legal_issue: Land acquisition proceedings under the former acquisition law lapse when an award was made at least five years before the new land acquisition law commenced and either possession was not taken or compensation was not paid.
material_facts: The award for the land was made more than five years before the new land acquisition law commenced.
Compensation for the land had not been paid to the landowner.
The landowner remained in physical possession of the land.

The acquiring authority asserted that possession had been taken, but actual possession had not been taken; the authority had not followed the required procedure for taking possession of a large tract, including a properly executed panchnama attested by independent witnesses.
issues.conclusion: The acquisition proceedings concerning the land had lapsed, and the acquisition notification was quashed insofar as it related to that land.
issues.legal_principle: Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 deems proceedings under the repealed Land Acquisition Act, 1894 to have lapsed if an award was made five years or more before commencement of the 2013 Act and possession was not taken or compensation was not paid. Under Pune Municipal Corporation v. Harakchand Misrimal Solanki, the legal fiction operates once those conditions are met, notwithstanding Section 114(2) of the 2013 Act read with Section 6 of the General Clauses Act, 1897. For taking possession of a large tract, a properly executed panchnama attested by independent witnesses is permissible; the Court relied on Sita Ram Bhandar Society v. Lt. Governor, Bhanda Development Authority v. Moti Lal Agarwal, Raghubir Singh Sehrawat v. State of Haryana, and Patasi Devi v. State of Haryana. The Court also followed Bharat Kumar v. State of Haryana, Bimla Devi v. State of Haryana, and Union of India v. Shiv Raj.

predicates.land_acquisition_proceeding: The matter concerns acquisition proceedings initiated under an earlier land acquisition regime.
predicates.award_made_at_least_five_years_before_ne: The acquisition award was made at least five years before the replacement land acquisition law commenced.
predicates.possession_not_taken: The acquiring authority had not taken actual possession of the acquired land.
predicates.compensation_not_paid: Compensation for the acquired land had not been paid to the landowner.

issues.definition: When an earlier-law land acquisition proceeding has an award made at least five years before the replacement law commenced, the proceedings lapse if possession was not taken or compensation was not paid.
